k_selection.mdl_note: gain as a fraction of the i.i.d. code length is the interpretable scale; a fraction below ~0.01 is a weak preference however large the bit count looks

mdl_calibration.note: permutation null not run (n_perm=0). Re-run with run(..., n_perm=199) for a p-value; cost is O(n_perm * T * m * n^3). The default evidence for real structure is result['post_clustering_inference'].

artifact_diagnostics.note: empty_stratum_ari compares the partition to the indicator 'carries none of this layer's features', and largest_group compares the largest group against the rest with the indicator 'carries none of any layer's features'; max_empty_stratum_ari is the larger of the two and a value at or above 0.5 means the grouping is the trait-absent stratum, an artefact of the empty-union distance convention rather than trait structure

layer_influence.regime_note: every layer reproduces the fused partition alone; the fusion adds nothing over the best single layer

baselines.note: ari_vs_fused says only whether a candidate agrees with the reported partition. mdl_gain is in sample and favours a likelihood-fitted candidate by construction. external_agreement is a point value; the paired difference in external_agreement_vs_reported carries the interval that says whether two candidates can be told apart. held_out is the feature-split test the reported partition must pass, run on each candidate's own pipeline. The reported partition is attested by its own held-out test; it is not claimed to be the best of these candidates, and the report states which candidates the data can and cannot separate.

lineage_concordance.note: the pair concordance, not AMI/ARI, is the primary statistic: with many singleton lineages AMI is chance-corrected towards zero even under strong clonal confounding

label_recoverability.note: recovery of the pipeline's own labels from half the features; internal coherence, not external predictive validity

gate_ledger.threshold: no tested simple rule has bootstrap CI95 low > 0

interpretation.scope_note: Highest claim supported by diagnostics applicable to this run; archetype_candidate is not causal, clinical or cross-cohort biological confirmation.
